reply.text:
Wanting to push harder is a good instinct, and the way to do it is progressive overload, not just grinding harder every session. Add a little weight or a rep or two when your last sets felt clean, and keep 1 or 2 reps in the tank on most working sets so you can repeat it next week.

Save the all-out efforts for the top set of a lift or a final set, and let the rest of the session build the base. Tell me which lift you want to push first and I'll look at what you've been doing on it.
